Definition: Shelomoth, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shelomoth is the name of two men, and both are keepers. One is a son of Shimei among the chief of the fathers of Laadan, and the other, with his brethren, was over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king and the chief fathers had dedicated. No profile of either survives apart from the lists.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe keepers of treasure are worth naming. Shelomoth guarded what David dedicated, and I hold that God remembers the hands that hold His gifts.
